title: How to Remove Post Image Gray Background | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: How to Remove Post Image Gray Background Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000098757 To remove the gray background behind the image on the post details page, you can use the Design Settings. Here's how: Navigate to your BD dashboard Go to the " D esign Settings " section Find the " General " tab Scroll down to " Additional Settings >> Content Boxes & Backgrounds " Here you will find the " Post Image Backgroun d " & " Photo Album Background " settings Use the RGB color picker to select a color You can learn more about the Content Boxes & Backgrounds settings here: https://bootstrap.brilliantdirectories.com/en/support/solutions/articles/12000046625 For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
